description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Colby Parkinson was a full participant in practice on Friday.
items.impact: Parkinson is on track to be good to go. He is off the fantasy radar in his current role.
items.title: Colby Parkinson (knee/shoulder) logs full practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Aaron Donald was a full participant in practice on Friday.
items.impact: Donald is well on track to return on Monday against the Bills.
items.title: Aaron Donald (back) logs full practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Joshua Palmer was added to the injury report with a shoulder issue on Friday.
items.impact: Palmer is a late addition to the injury report. He remains off the fantasy radar.
items.title: Joshua Palmer (shoulder) added to injury report

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: DJ Moore did not practice on Friday.
items.impact: Moore will likely have to practice in some capacity on Saturday to have a chance to play on Monday.
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) misses practice Friday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kaelon Black is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Black will remain a change-of-pace role alongside Christian McCaffrey.
items.title: Kaelon Black (illness) off injury report Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Isaiah Likely is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Commanders.
items.impact: Likely hauled in seven passes last week. He remains a borderline TE1/TE2 play for fantasy managers.
items.title: Isaiah Likely (knee/groin) off injury report Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jeremiyah Love is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Lions.
items.impact: Love is officially good to go as expected. He will be an RB2 play for fantasy managers.
items.title: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) off injury report Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Walter Nolen III is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Lions.
items.impact: Nolen should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into Sunday.
items.title: Walter Nolen III (calf) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Mykel Williams is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Williams is expected to return for the first time since tearing his ACL in Week 9 of last season.
items.title: Mykel Williams (knee) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Pat Bryant (ankle) is being placed on injured reserve and will be out for the next four weeks at least.
items.impact: Bryant recently suffered an ankle injury, and it is serious enough that the team is placing him on short-term injured reserve. That means that he will be sidelined for the next four weeks at least, but it sounds like he's expected to make his return sometime not too long after that. Troy Franklin and Courtland Sutton are both likely to see more work for the Broncos for the foreseeable future in his absence.
items.title: Pat Bryant (ankle) placed on injured reserve

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Nick Bosa has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Bosa is hopeful to return in Week 6 against the Commanders.
items.title: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Mike Evans is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Evans returned to practice on Friday. He will be a WR2 play for fantasy managers.
items.title: Mike Evans (ribs) off injury report Sunday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Keenan Allen (groin) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Allen is still dealing with a groin injury and will be questionable to play heading into the weekend. If he's ruled out ahead of game time, fantasy managers should expect more work for Darius Slayton (knee) against the Steelers this week.
items.title: Keenan Allen (groin) officially questionable for Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Raiders will not activate Dont'e Thornton Jr. this week.
items.impact: Thornton was able to return to practice. He remains week-to-week.
items.title: Dont'e Thornton Jr. (hamstring) will not be activated Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jalen Nailor has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Patriots.
items.impact: Nailor will remain sidelined in concussion protocol.
items.title: Jalen Nailor (concussion) ruled out Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Channing Canada has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
items.impact: Canada is one of four defensive backs ruled out for the Patriots on Sunday.
items.title: Channing Canada ruled out Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Karon Prunty has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Raiders.

items.title: Karon Prunty ruled out Sunday

items.desc: Divine Deablo is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Deablo was limited in practice on Thursday and Friday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable.
items.title: Divine Deablo (hamstring) listed questionable Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Za'Darius Smith is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
items.impact: Smith returned to a limited practice on Friday. He will have to clear all protocols by Saturday.
items.title: Za'Darius Smith (concussion) listed questionable Sunday

items.title: Jake Matthews (groin) listed questionable Sunday
